description: Google's hosted Gmail MCP server (preview). Search and read mail, write drafts, and manage labels, trash and spam. It cannot send mail.
job: Find and read emails, write drafts and sort your Gmail inbox

write.label: Add or remove labels on emails
Move emails to trash or spam
Restore emails from trash or spam

example_prompts: Summarize the unread emails I got today
Find emails from our accountant about last quarter's taxes and list what they need from me
Draft a reply to the latest email about the office lease asking for the signed copy

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Creates a new draft email in the authenticated user's Gmail account. Returns a Draft object with the `id`, `threadId`, and `viewUrl` fields populated.

tools.name: list_drafts
tools.description: Lists draft emails from the authenticated user's Gmail account, optionally filtered by a query string. An empty JSON object `{}` represents zero matching items, not an error.

tools.name: get_draft
tools.description: Retrieves a specific draft email from the authenticated user's Gmail account by ID, including its `viewUrl` for viewing and editing in the Gmail Web UI.

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Retrieves a specific email thread from the authenticated user's Gmail account, including its `viewUrl` and a list of its messages (each with their own `viewUrl`).

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Retrieves a specific email message from the authenticated user's Gmail account by its unique message ID, including its `viewUrl`.

tools.name: search_threads
tools.description: Lists email threads from the authenticated user's Gmail account. This tool can filter threads based on a query string and supports pagination.

tools.name: label_thread
tools.description: Adds labels to an entire thread in the authenticated user's Gmail account. This operation affects all messages currently in the thread and any future messages added to it.

tools.name: unlabel_thread
tools.description: Removes labels from an entire thread in the authenticated user's Gmail account. This operation affects all messages currently in the thread.

tools.name: apply_sensitive_thread_label
tools.description: Prefer `trash_thread` or `mark_thread_spam` instead. Adds a sensitive label (Trash or Spam) to a single thread in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

tools.name: trash_thread
tools.description: Moves an entire thread to the Trash in the authenticated user's Gmail account. This operation affects all messages currently in the thread.

tools.name: untrash_thread
tools.description: Removes an entire thread from the Trash in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

tools.name: mark_thread_spam
tools.description: Marks an entire thread as Spam in the authenticated user's Gmail account. This operation affects all messages currently in the thread.

tools.name: unmark_thread_spam
tools.description: Unmarks an entire thread as Spam in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: Lists all labels available in the authenticated user's Gmail account. Use this tool to discover the `id` of a label before calling `label_thread`, `unlabel_thread`, `label_message`, or `unlabel_message`.

tools.name: label_message
tools.description: Adds one or more labels to a specific message in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

tools.name: update_message_labels
tools.description: Atomically adds and/or removes labels from a specific message in the authenticated user's Gmail account. Requires at least one of `addLabelIds` or `removeLabelIds` to be provided.

tools.name: unlabel_message
tools.description: Removes one or more labels from a specific message in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

tools.name: apply_sensitive_message_label
tools.description: Prefer `trash_message` or `mark_message_spam` instead. Adds a sensitive label (Trash or Spam) to a single message in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

tools.name: trash_message
tools.description: Moves a specific message to the Trash in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

tools.name: untrash_message
tools.description: Removes a specific message from the Trash in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

tools.name: mark_message_spam
tools.description: Marks a specific message as Spam in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

tools.name: unmark_message_spam
tools.description: Unmarks a specific message as Spam in the authenticated user's Gmail account.

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Creates a new label in the authenticated user's Gmail account. Supports creating nested labels (sub-labels) using a forward slash (e.g., 'Projects/Alpha/Sprint-1').
